run_test_suite_with_runner: run a unittest test suite using the Runner class with optional dedicated threads
capture_stdout_stderr_with_capturefile: capture stdout or stderr output by using CaptureFile as a context manager
retrieve_captured_output_bytes: retrieve captured output bytes from a CaptureFile instance after redirection
create_augmented_case_with_uuid: create an AugmentedCase wrapping a TestCase with a guaranteed unique UUID identifier
skip_tests_in_runner: skip specific tests in the Runner by calling skip_tests with a list of test IDs
